title: An `id` of `__proto__`
why: `__proto__` is a perfectly good path segment and a catastrophic object key: `statuses[id] = …` in the browser mutates the prototype instead of creating the own-property the contract requires, while the offline map stores it normally. Two defences — the reserved names are rejected, **and** the browser builds `statuses` as a `Map` or a null-prototype object — and this fixture makes an implementation using `{}` fail visibly rather than silently.
